name: effort-cycle
description: Alt+↑ steps the effort level up and Alt+↓ down (Ctrl+↑ and Ctrl+↓ too, and Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E once bound), for the main thread or the subagent in view; the footer shows that agent's model and level as they change, with a ‹ and › to click while the pointer is over it

nudgeRows.title: Tasks list rows: update at once
nudgeRows.description: When a subagent's level changes, narrow the terminal one column and back, so its tasks list row follows in about 0.4 s instead of up to 5 s. Costs two repaints per change and a brief one-column flicker at the right edge; needs python3. Relies on Claude Code internals.
